== Biography ==
Charlotte was born about 1761.
== Research Notes ==
=== Birth estimate ===

Charlotte's birth about 1761 is an unverified estimate. The 1841 Nettleham census citation below concerns the household associated with [[Glasgow-2965|William Glasgow]]; it does not independently establish Charlotte's birth surname, exact birth date or birthplace.

=== Possible York marriage licence, 1832 ===

A marriage licence dated 29 March 1832 names William Glasgow, aged 62, and Charlotte Wise, aged 44, both of York, Yorkshire. The intended marriage place was St Cuthbert, York.<ref name="YorkLicence1832">Findmypast, ''Yorkshire, Archbishop Of York Marriage Licences Index, 1613–1839'', [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=GBPRS%2FOR%2FYORK%2FM%2F00141645%2F1 William Glasgow and Charlotte Wise, GBPRS/OR/YORK/M/00141645/1], licence 29 March 1832, sequence 30, page 130. William aged 62, residence parish York; Charlotte aged 44, parish York; intended marriage St Cuthbert, York. Provider derivative transcript inspected 4 November 2026; original licence and marriage entry uninspected.</ref>

[[Glasgow-2965|William Glasgow]] and his wife [[Unknown-695645|Charlotte]] are a possible couple comparison. William's uncertain 1771 birth is close to the licence age, which would place birth between 30 March 1769 and 29 March 1770 if it records completed years. Charlotte's estimated birth about 1761 differs substantially from the licence age of 44, which would place birth between 30 March 1787 and 29 March 1788. That is a real discrepancy requiring investigation. Her weak birth estimate does not by itself exclude her, but the shared forenames and couple cannot establish the identification. The Lincolnshire census account does not yet supply a documented link to York.

The licence records an intended marriage, not proof that a marriage took place. It gives no parents, previous marital status or evidence that Wise was Charlotte's birth surname. Charlotte's birth surname remains unknown. The original licence, any resulting St Cuthbert marriage entry and the Nettleham census household ages should be compared before assigning this event, changing a name or adopting an age-derived birth year. No birth, marriage or relationship is established by this comparison.
